conclusions: The exact Running-only predicate returns false for RanToCompletion, Faulted and Canceled tasks, and true for a live Running task.
Calling Task.Dispose while the task is still Running throws InvalidOperationException in this .NET 4.8-targeted probe.
After the running task is released and completed, Dispose succeeds; Dispose did not perform cancellation or waiting.
boundaries: The probe verifies .NET Task semantics and the predicate shape in isolation; it does not execute production Machine, Worker, Stop, Abort or EmergencyStop code.
No hardware, VM, database, UI or production Task instance was touched.
Production integration still requires a safe managed fixture or a controlled runtime environment.
